CustomField.label: Action Name
CustomField.description: The API name of what runs: the flow or the quick action. For an object's quick action use Object.ActionName (for example Account.NewCase); for a global quick action use the name alone (for example LogACall).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: API name of the flow or the quick action. For an object's quick action use Object.ActionName, such as Account.NewCase.
